hardening.minimized_reason: No feature-minimization claim has been established for this package.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: Authelia for werewolf's authelia form, as Wolfi would package it: built by melange in Wolfi's environment, its web portal with Wolfi's Node and the pnpm upstream names, then the server with Wolfi's Go, the portal embedded, as upstream's authelia-scripts build does. SQLite is Wolfi's, linked (the libsqlite3 tag), so its fixes reach a machine with the rest of its packages (cmd/howl/melange.zig checks what it links). Go fetches its modules, which go.sum pins, and pnpm its packages, which pnpm-lock.yaml pins. Offered to wolfi-dev/os as it is; when Wolfi ships it, the form names the package and this file goes.
changes.why: Provide an independently maintained application context with immutable sources and separately updatable Wolfi dependencies.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi provides equivalent packaging, supported versions, architectures and required hardening; review compatibility before retiring this context.
